items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: it was made by Gann who was a violin maker in Miracourt

ctx.x: the Esquire 45 mentions you as being with whose band or as being an outstanding bass player or what?

just just an individual yes mm-hmm now you're saying about that bass you got from Charlie Rittner oh well I got it's it's a half-size bass and it was made by Gann who was a violin maker in Miracourt and he also states that he got the wood for this particular instrument out of the was it Vorgias forest I think that's the way they pronounce it uh it's French in other words yes yes uh and uh it still bears the scars down on the bottom part of the instrument below the F hole and to the side of the tailpiece where he…

oh did you ever know a piano player that played around Galveston and Beaumont named Lazy Daddy was a colored piano player he worked with Buddy Petit Edmund Hall told me about him and I think Punk Johnson told him but I doubt if you'd know him but it's just an off chance
